pmcro.seed.purpose: start or continue an autonomous cycle

governance.audit.reference.purpose: reference tamper-evident governance/audit evidence without copying the external audit log

outcome.attestation.purpose: post-action verification of observed outcome linked to execution and governance evidence

model.request.purpose: provider-neutral request for external or local inference

model.response.purpose: normalized captured model response; untrusted until checked

procedure.candidate.purpose: recorded reusable procedure candidate linked to source trails

procedure.replay.purpose: request replay through an explicitly registered computer-use adapter

evaluation.score.purpose: deterministic score from explicit observed metrics

procedure.promotion.purpose: checker-backed decision to promote or loop a repeated procedure corpus

agent.identity.assertion.purpose: self-narrated identity statement; carries no authority by itself

federation.round.purpose: shared seed, bounds, contestants, and budget for one orchestrator competition round

federation.submission.purpose: validated contestant result/evidence reference under one round

federation.referee.verdict.purpose: independent settlement evidence; referee must not be a contestant

federation.winner.summary.purpose: concise evidence-backed winning strategy summary without private internal reasoning

confidentiality.classification.purpose: declared-label confidentiality classification; no inference of undisclosed sensitive facts

confidentiality.disclosure.purpose: minimum-necessary disclosure artifact bound to grants and agreement references

learning.promotion.request.purpose: request to cross operational evidence into a separately governed sanitized learning artifact

learning.artifact.purpose: sanitized consent/policy-bound reusable learning artifact; raw trail excluded

resource.registration.purpose: content-addressed validated resource registration backed by independent checker PASS

resource.resolution.purpose: planner-facing admissibility result from verified registry state

resource.revocation.purpose: append-only revocation that removes admissibility without deleting provenance

economics.usage.purpose: append-only usage/cost/value evidence; not a charge or authority grant

economics.heartbeat.purpose: WAKE/SLEEP/RECOVER decision for the cheap always-on company control plane

economics.entitlement.purpose: managed-service quota decision; local/self-hosted execution remains unmetered

economics.unit-summary.purpose: explicit unit-economics evidence linked to verified outcomes

template.bootstrap.request.purpose: request generation of customer-owned PMCR-O bootstrap surfaces for a repository

template.bootstrap.result.purpose: return bootstrap plan/output evidence; remote mutation remains a separate workflow action

dialogue.frame.purpose: addressable linguistic frame for assert/ask/challenge/propose/respond/summarize/handoff/acknowledge; carries no authority and cannot jump outer phases

intent.interpretation.purpose: derived interpretation linked to immutable source intent; never replaces the original intent
